summary.text: Everlasting sorrow is a famous killer move. Only Wan Gu Chou, who cultivates both time path and wisdom path, can use it.

claims.text: After a recital that names wind, dust, flowers, and the sorrow of myriad ages, heaven and earth turn dark. Cold mournful wind and bleak clouds fill the sky. Inside several li, living beings of both sides feel intense sorrow. Dejection, disappointment, depression, and worry make people shed tears and feel stifled. Fang clan’s six Immortal Gu Houses around Myriad Age Building shake and almost fall. Fang Di Chang half-kneels in Thought Expelling Pavilion, blood seeping from mouth and nose. Fang Gong ages rapidly as close to one hundred years are extracted from his lifespan.

Watching immortals name Wan Gu Chou as Wan clan’s strongest peak rank eight, who lived for ten thousand years and created Myriad Age Building. Her move everlasting sorrow is famous throughout history. Only she who cultivates both time path and wisdom path can use it, and only she can amplify it to such a degree through Myriad Age Building. The watching immortals judge that the move already possesses the air of pseudo venerable level.

Wan Gu Chou stops the killer move and tells the alliance to attack. Fang clan is struck by everlasting sorrow. The sorrowful and depressive feelings are hard to get rid of. They cannot even use twenty percent of their battle strength and retreat in defeat.

Wan Gu Chou is revived by Heavenly Court. A lot of her rank eight time path Immortal Gu are lent by Heavenly Court. Even her everlasting sorrow killer move was personally modified by Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Lu Wei Yin calls everlasting sorrow an amazing killer move. It is a compound killer move created from time path and wisdom path. Once the target’s feelings are influenced, lifespan decreases rapidly. The decreased lifespan strengthens the move, making the sorrowful emotions more violent. The emotions shroud the heart, and the target’s battle intent falls to a minimum.
Fang Hua Sheng says the killer move is a lot different from the historical records. He tried to treat it, but many negative emotions remain and can only dissipate slowly with time.

Lu Wei Yin brings a rank seven wisdom path Immortal Gu that his alliance leader specially refined. With this Gu it is easy to remove remnant power of everlasting sorrow. Several killer moves with that Gu as the core exist. One of them can defend against everlasting sorrow, albeit with difficulty.

Fang Di Chang says that had he known venerables can easily revive Gu Immortals, he would have been on guard against a threat like Wan Gu Chou. Had Fang clan known about Wan Gu Chou, it would not have sent all six Immortal Gu Houses to attack Myriad Age Building, since her killer move had a limited range.
He also says that Fang clan might have exchanged for that forgotten sorrow Immortal Gu earlier, and that if the clan could have defended against Wan Gu Chou’s killer move, it would not have lost.
